description: This file contains unit tests for the urandom random number generator in BoringSSL, using Google Test framework. It includes tests that simulate system call behaviors and verify the correctness of the urandom implementation, especially in relation to system calls like getrandom, open, read, socket, and connect, with platform-specific code for x86_64 and AARCH64 architectures.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: Represents a system call event observed during tracing, including types like getrandom, open, read, socket, connect, and abort.

classes.name: SyscallResult
classes.description: A helper class similar to std::optional<int> to handle syscall return values.

methods.name: regs_read
methods.description: Fetches register state of a traced process, architecture-specific implementation.

methods.name: regs_set_ret
methods.description: Sets the return value of a syscall in the traced process.

methods.name: regs_break_syscall
methods.description: Forces a syscall to fail by modifying register state.

methods.name: GetTrace
methods.description: Runs a function in a forked process, traces system calls, and records events, simulating failures based on flags.

methods.name: TestFunction
methods.description: Function that performs dummy RAND_bytes calls, used as target for tracing.

methods.name: AppendDaemonEvents
methods.description: Simulates daemon socket events for testing.

methods.name: TestFunctionPRNGModel
methods.description: Models expected behavior of urandom.c code for testing.

methods.name: CheckInvariants
methods.description: Verifies certain invariants in the trace, e.g., no blocking getrandom with RDRAND.
